content.$t:
Another "lost and found" gem by Alampo Records. Disciplina plays a concrete noiz-ambient and for some strange reasons, also, this CD-r is not available not their Bandcamp Page. Limited edition of 97 copies.

  Alampo Records was created in 2001 to release on CDr music from Criopalmos and related projects. Previously the same musicians released on tapes as Lanzoni Records, Bolgia Folk, Noir Tapes and NecroNovi.

 If you are into: noise industrial, abstract ambient and the likes then you`ll love this one. Enjoy it.
